decisions.reasoning: XAUUSD.x closed at 4187.110 above the prior-12 high 4186.475, a 0.635 breakout equal to 0.050 ATR. Six-bar and 12-bar changes align at +33.961 (+2.69 ATR) and +29.229 (+2.32 ATR). Latest spread 0.490 is 0.97x the prior-12 median and 0.039 ATR, passing both liquidity limits. The 04:00-06:00 consolidation held above 4168.859 before the 07:00 resumption closed through resistance. A BUY_STOP at 4190.50 confirms above the latest 4189.86 high; stop 4175.50 sits below the latest bar low and the breakout body, while target 4217.50 remains inside the prior-12 range-height projection. Entry risk is 15.00 and reward is 27.00, estimated 1.80R. EURUSD, GBPUSD, AUDUSD and NZDUSD retain positive directional changes while USDCAD and USDCHF are negative, supporting the short-USD side of gold. AUDUSD, NZDUSD, USDCHF, GBPAUD, CHFJPY and AUDJPY are rejected as extended beyond 0.80 ATR; EURGBP, EURCAD and GBPCAD fail the 0.15-ATR spread cap. Score 9/10: structure 2, momentum 2, entry 2, spread/liquidity 1, reward/risk 2, cross-market/exposure 0 because account exposure is unverified.
